title: The DOJ says it got court authorization to seize or restrain $1.2B of the $2.7B frozen by Tether and Circle after North Korea's $6.3B Binance hack on October 29 (Myles Miller/Bloomberg)
summary: Myles Miller / Bloomberg: The DOJ says it got court authorization to seize or restrain $1.2B of the $2.7B frozen by Tether and Circle after North Korea's $6.3B Binance hack on October 29 — The Justice Department says it's joined with the two biggest stablecoin issuers in efforts to secure almost half the money stolen …
